{{Top|leg}}
'''Camaa''' was a city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fremond III]]. It was the location of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Glaffold]]'s government offices during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was also the site of a key [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base until its [[Siege on Fremond III|siege]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
